# dsh-token-breakdown-stats
English | 中文

A dsh plugin (`dsh-plugin`
topic) that replaces the composer-dock statistics pill so a session's tok

en
total covers the **main agent plus every subagent it called**, with a
click-open breakdown by bil
ling bucket, by subagent, and by model.
## Summary

The composer-dock statistics pill in a dsh session reports only the **main
agent's** token usage. Wh

en that agent delegates to subagents, every token the
subagents spend is invisible in the session fo

at agent delegates to subagents, every token the
subagents spend is invisible in the session footer.

This plugin replaces that pill so the footer reports the **session total —
main agent plus every sub

agent it called** — and its click-open dialog
itemizes the usage by billing bucket, by subagent, and

alled** — and its click-open dialog
itemizes the usage by billing bucket, by subagent, and by model.
## What changes
| | shipped pill | this plugin |
| Pill label | main-agent total + cache hit | **session total** (main + subagents) + cache hit + sub

agent count |
| Dialog | four billing buckets | buckets, main/subagent split, subagent aggregate, pe

r-model rows |
| Time/activity pill | turns, steps, speed, timings | unchanged (reproduced) |

Subagents are reported as an **aggregate** everywhere: the pill shows how many
there were, and the d

ialog folds them into one block (count, how many are still
running, share of the session, and the su

mmed buckets). No per-subagent rows —
a session can spawn dozens, and the per-child detail already l

ives in the
subagent catalog in the session header.
The dialog shows:

- **总用量** — the four disjoint billing buckets (uncached input, cache read,
cache write, output) plus

cache hit, over the whole session tree.
- **主 Agent** — the provider/model routes observed in the l

oaded turns, and
that session's own buckets.
- **子 Agent（N）** — one aggregate block: how many were d

iscovered, how many
are still running, their share of the session total, and the folded buckets.
- *

*按模型** — per provider/model totals folded from the loaded turns.
- A friendly note when the session
has not called any subagent yet.
## How it works

The composer statistics dock changed shape in DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, so the plugin
mirrors whichever rows
the shipped `ui-chat` bundle registers:
| DSH | Shipped `conversation.composer.dock` rows | This plugin registers |

| `0.2.0-rc.2` | one cell, id `stats`, order 0 | (single-cell form, `StatsPills`) |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` |
`activity` order 0 **and** `usage` order 1 | `activity` order 0 **and** `usage` order 1 |

A list slot matches a registration to a shipped row by **id + priority**: the
lowest priority for a

given id renders, so reusing the shipped id at a strictly
lower `priority` **replaces** that control

. Registering an id the shipped bundle
does not use **adds** a control instead — which is exactly ho

w the old single
`stats` row surfaced as duplicated pills once the dock split in two.

Both of this plugin's cells therefore pass `priority: -1`, strictly below the
shipped rows' default
0, and each renders exactly one pill:

- `activity` → turn/step counts with whole-session speed
- `usage` → session token total covering ev

→ turn/step counts with whole-session speed
- `usage` → session token total covering every subagent

They are registered from one `slots.inject` generator, exactly as the shipped
row does, so they shar
e a disposal scope and cannot half-mount.

Every figure rides durable projections, so paging and compaction cannot change
them:

- `tokenUsage` — the four disjoint provider billing buckets per session.
- `subagentCatalog` — direc

t children of a session, in parent event order,
with mode and optional label.
- `SessionSummary.proj

ectionValues` — the same projections plus the subagent
identity (`label`) and timing, addressed by s

ession id.
- `ChatSnapshot.nodes.values()` — the keyed store of every materialized Chat
Node. `turn-

tail` rows deliberately make no contribution to `legacy.nodes`,
so this is the only place the per-tu

rn `routes` (provider/model) can be read
from; the legacy slice still feeds the step-count fold.

The `compact` / `detailed` preference is read from the same `ui-chat` config
scope the shipped pill

uses; `compact` keeps the plain speed and cache-hit
readings without dialogs.
## Known limitations

- **Per-subagent model attribution is unavailable.** The client-side
`tokenUsage` projection carries

only the four buckets — no route — so a
subagent's row shows its total, not its model. Model attrib

ution covers the
main session's loaded turns.
- **Descendants are a best-effort walk.** `subagentCat

alog` is the direct
children of a session; grandchildren appear only once their own catalog has
been

loaded (the same rule the shipped subagent catalog follows). Nothing is
invented for unloaded level

s.
- **Model attribution covers loaded turns.** `turn-tail` rows exist only for
closed turns inside

the loaded window, so on a long, paged session the model
row and the by-model section can lag the du

rable totals. In this version the
chat target's assistant nodes carry no `providerMetadata`, so ther

e is no
second source to fall back on — the row shows the session's models only once
at least one cl

osed turn is loaded.
- **Compact mode** keeps the shipped behavior (speed and cache hit only).

The inserted row id is `token-breakdown-stats`. Restart the app (or let the

it) and the pill in the composer dock is replaced.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (the plugin reads `ChatSnapshot.nodes`,
`SessionSummary.projectio

nValues`, and matches the split
`conversation.composer.dock` rows `activity` and `usage`). On
`0.2.0

-rc.2` the dock still had the single `stats` cell, which this plugin
no longer targets.
- A desktop
or web profile; the Web GUI renders the pills.
